name: @hughescr/oxlint-plugin-module-boundaries
description: Oxlint JS plugin for module boundaries: one policy file for allowed layer imports, type-only edges and module entry files, plus @internal export rules, with no TypeScript program
author: Craig Hughes <craig.npm@rungie.com>

scripts.lint: node node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint --deny-warnings --format unix && node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js -c eslint.package-json.config.mjs package.json && bun run check:ast-grep
scripts.lint:fix: node node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint --fix && node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js -c eslint.package-json.config.mjs --fix package.json
scripts.lint:overview: node node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint --deny-warnings && node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js -c eslint.package-json.config.mjs package.json && bun run check:ast-grep
scripts.test:full: bun run lint;bun run typecheck;bun run mutate
scripts.postversion: git commit -m "Bump package version to $npm_package_version" package.json; git flow release start $npm_package_version; git flow release finish -m $npm_package_version $npm_package_version; git checkout develop; git merge main
